items.title: Clarence "Little Dad" Vincent Interview, 1959-12-03
items.q: Yeah, we come up together, me and him.

ctx.x: Robert Thomas. Robert Thomas. Robert Thomas. Thomas Thomas. You don't mean Kit Thomas, huh? Robert Thomas. Play trombone. Oh. They call him Bob. Yeah. Ooh, they'll be Bob come up together. Yeah, he's a place to play with us. Bob, I don't know if he's playing yet. He's sick. No. He's sick. Yeah. Sick. He's sick. Oh, yeah. He's been sick a good while. He ain't got up there about twice with pennies, you know. And then he left and went to Baton Rouge. Yeah, we used to call him Bob. Bob Thomas, you know. Yeah, we come…
Ask him if he knows Lucci.
